''For the card with the same title, see [[Homefront (TTWT)]].''

'''Homefront''' is the 5th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on 6 August 2010. The set consists of 36 cards. This set is part of the ''Core Block'' consisting of cards from [[Homefront]], [[Homefront II]], [[Homefront III]], [[Homefront IV]], [[Homefront V]], and [[Homefront VI]].

==Rarity Breakdown==
*18 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*10 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Bajoran, 1 Borg, 1 Cardassian, 1 Dominion, 2 Federation, 1 Ferengi, 1 Klingon and 2 Romulan)
*8 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]

*36 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
